title: Four Jewels
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

In this world, there are $K$ types of gems numbered from $1$ to $K(=4)$. The value per unit size of a gem of type $i$ is $W_i$.

Snuke has $N$ gems. The $i$-th gem is of type $A_i$ and has size $B_i$. Also, Snuke has $N$ boxes, where the $i$-th box has size $i$.

Snuke will now put one gem in each box. When a gem's size is larger than the box, the gem is cut to fit in the box. That is, when gem $i$ is put in box $j$, its value becomes $W_{A_i} \times \min(B_i, j)$.

Find the maximum possible sum of gem values.

## Constraints

- $K = 4$
- $1 \leq W_1 < W_2 < \cdots < W_K \leq 10^6$
- $1 \leq N \leq 250000$
- $1 \leq A_i \leq K$
- $1 \leq B_i \leq N$
- All input values are integers.

## Input

The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N K
W_1 W_2 \ldots W_K
A_1 B_1
A_2 B_2
\vdots
A_N B_N
```

## Output

Output the answer.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

在这个世界上，有 $K$ 种宝石，编号从 $1$ 到 $K(=4)$。类型为 $i$ 的宝石每单位尺寸的价值为 $W_i$。

Snuke 有 $N$ 颗宝石。第 $i$ 颗宝石的类型为 $A_i$，尺寸为 $B_i$。此外，Snuke 还有 $N$ 个箱子，其中第 $i$ 个箱子的尺寸为 $i$。

Snuke 现在要向每个箱子中各放入一颗宝石。当宝石的尺寸大于箱子时，宝石会被切割以装入箱子。也就是说，当把宝石 $i$ 放入箱子 $j$ 时，其价值变为 $W_{A_i} \times \min(B_i, j)$。

求宝石价值之和的最大可能值。

## 约束条件

- $K = 4$
- $1 \leq W_1 < W_2 < \cdots < W_K \leq 10^6$
- $1 \leq N \leq 250000$
- $1 \leq A_i \leq K$
- $1 \leq B_i \leq N$
- 所有输入值均为整数。

## 输入格式

输入通过标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
N K
W_1 W_2 \ldots W_K
A_1 B_1
A_2 B_2
\vdots
A_N B_N
```

## 输出格式

输出答案。

samples.note: If gems $1, 2, 3$ are put in boxes $3, 1, 2$, respectively, the sum of values is $4 \times \min(2, 3) + 1 \times \min(3, 1) + 3 \times \min(2, 2) = 15$, which is maximum.
